definition: gap = Apple VIX (30-day implied volatility) minus Apple's 21-session realised volatility, both annualised, in volatility points. Settled gap compares the Apple VIX from 21 sessions ago with the volatility realised since then.

tests.label: One-year average of the settled gap is at or below 0
